title: Mage Power
source: Engine-ready authored setup/solution for this pass; canonical A01 solution is in canon_reference. No decoded GBA fixed-board table was available when this script was authored. P015 uses a Trap for the Set step because the current A04 SetSpellTrap API only accepts Traps and Quick-Play Spells.
notes: Set Seven Tools of the Bandit, then Mage Power counts two own Spell/Trap Cards: 1600 + 1000 = 2600. The Set card is deliberately a Trap so the authored set_spell_trap action is legal in the engine.

canon_reference.setup_status: unknown in A01; this pass ships an engine-ready authored setup
solution_steps: Activate Release Restraint, sacrifce Iron Knight and summon Gearfried the Swordmaster.
Equip Swordmaster with Lightning Blade and destroy Maiden of the Aqua with his effect.
Enter Battle Phase and attack Crab Turtle.
canon_reference.note: Canonical solution is recorded for traceability. The fixed board, time limit and reward below are authored and may need revision when A01 publishes the original setup.
